title: A foreign connection's commit drops all transcript baselines (persist.rs:1922), so the next tick rewrites every changed session in full
outcome: A commit by another connection to the state store no longer discards the persist writer's transcript baselines for rows that connection did not touch, so ordinary deltas stay differential.
acceptance: A foreign connection's commit drops all transcript baselines (persist.rs:1922), so the next tick rewrites every changed session in full is done
